title: TYLOO’s Lisbon forfeit dents Singapore Major hopes as 100 Thieves edge out fnatic
summary:
TYLOO's withdrawal from a HyperX Retake Season 13 quarter-final in Lisbon has left their PGL Major Singapore invite in doubt on cutoff day. In Europe, fnatic are shut out of the last CS2 Major of 2026 after the final weekend's results went against them.

title: d4v41 and Jinggg leave Paper Rex after 7th–8th Champions finish, Pacific place secure
summary:
Paper Rex has parted with captain d4v41 and Jinggg, two Masters Toronto winners, after an early exit at Champions 2026. With its VCT Pacific partner place secure, the Singapore organisation is rebuilding by choice as free agency opens to every region.

title: Gentle Mates GC come from a map down to beat Shopify Rebellion Gold and reach Game Changers final
summary:
